tex_content.html:
Proposition
1. ch3:3.1Let $(M,g)$ be a Riemannian manifold.

  1. If $M$ is isotropic at one point and homogeneous, then it is isotropic.

  2. If $M$ is frame-homogeneous, then it is homogeneous and isotropic.

Proof

\sketch For (a), conjugating the isotropy action by an isometry carrying the distinguished point to an arbitrary point transfers transitivity on unit vectors. For (b), transitivity on orthonormal frames implies transitivity on their base points and on their first unit vectors.

□
